c4_draft_rules: 4h closed bars; signal bar `b`.
EMA50 of close (the existing implementation, as in C3); ATR14 (Wilder).
The earliest `b` is 220. Every referenced value must be finite, and ATR > 0.
Range regime, declared from closed bars `b−30..b−1` only. Bar `b` is never part of the box.
Box: RH = max(high[b−30..b−1]), RL = min(low[b−30..b−1]), W = RH − RL, M = (RH + RL)/2.
Width: 4.0·ATR[b−1] ≤ W ≤ 12.0·ATR[b−1]. The range must be wide enough for a medium-horizon R and target, and not so wide that it is really a trend leg.
Flat mean: |EMA50[b−1] − EMA50[b−13]| ≤ 0.5·ATR[b−1].
Low efficiency: ER = |C[b−1] − C[b−31]| / Σ_{i=b−30..b−1} |C[i] − C[i−1]| ≤ 0.30. If the denominator is 0, the regime fails.
Long trigger at the close of `b` (shorts are the exact mirror: RH ↔ RL, high ↔ low, every comparison inverted).
Excursion: low[b] ≤ RL − 0.10·ATR[b−1]. This is a real probe below the range.
Not a breakdown: low[b] ≥ RL − 1.50·ATR[b−1].
Rejection / re-entry: C[b] > RL (strict), and close location (C − low)/(high − low) ≥ 0.60. If high = low, the trigger fails.
Room to the mean: C[b] < M (strict).
Entry at open[b+1].
Stop = low[b] − 0.25·ATR[b]. Skip if entry ≤ stop.
R = entry − stop. Quality guard: skip if R > 2.5·ATR[b].
Target = M, frozen at signal time. Skip if (M − entry) < 1.0·R, so the reward to the mean must be at least 1R.
Cost guard: skip unless R / entry ≥ 1.0%.
Skip order: entry ≤ stop → R cap (`quality`) → target room (`room`) → cost guard.
Regime-break invalidation: C < low[b] (strict) at the close of any bar from b+1 on, i.e. acceptance below the excursion low, exits at the next open. Equality does not invalidate.
Time cap: decided at the close of b+24, exit at open b+25 (4 days).

Exit priority, slot rules, costs and funding: identical to the accepted C2/C3 convention. A gap through the stop or target at the open owns the label. Otherwise the intrabar stop beats the target, and invalidation beats the time cap. A signal at close x−1 is ignored when the trade exits at open x. An open_end trade owns the slot.
One slot per symbol, both sides combined.

A qualifying signal consumes its setup whether it is taken, skipped (no-next-bar, gap, quality, room or cost) or overlap-ignored. Then the next signal on that symbol, either side, needs `b′ ≥ b + 7`. A candidate that fails a gate does not consume, and a blocked candidate does not extend the cooldown.
The same-bar long/short conflict is unreachable, since a bar cannot close both above RL with location ≥ 0.6 and below RH with location ≤ 0.4. Assert it and test it by injection.
RH and RL ties do not matter, because only the values are used.
Worst-case cost at the guard minimum (R/E = 1.0%): fees and slippage 0.14R plus funding over 25 closes × 5e-5 / 1% = 0.125R, about 0.265R.

frozen_c4_lifecycle: A signal is a candidate passing every regime and trigger rule. It consumes the cross-side cooldown whether taken, no-next-bar, entry/stop gap-skipped, quality/room/cost-skipped or overlap-ignored. A candidate failing regime/trigger does not consume; a cooldown-blocked candidate does not extend the cooldown.
Trade-skip order is entry/stop gap -> R cap quality -> target room -> cost. Target and stop are frozen at signal time. A gap entry beyond the mean therefore fails room.
One combined-side slot. A trade exiting at open x still blocks a signal at close x-1. open_end owns the slot.

Exit priority and cost/funding arithmetic are the accepted C2/C3 convention: gap stop/target owns the label; otherwise pending close-rule fill precedes intrabar checks; intrabar stop beats target; invalidation beats time when decided together. Time exit funding uses the accepted inclusive e..x convention (25 funding bars here).
Same-bar L/S conflict is asserted unreachable for a valid nonzero-range trigger and must be injection-tested.
frozen_c4_parameters: 4h closed bars; earliest b=220; EMA50 uses the existing adjust=False recurrence seeded from close[0]; ATR14 is the accepted Wilder implementation. Every referenced value is finite and ATR >0.
Box is exactly the inclusive bars b-30..b-1. RH=max high, RL=min low, W=RH-RL, M=(RH+RL)/2. Bar b is excluded.

Regime: 4.0*ATR[b-1] <= W <= 12.0*ATR[b-1]; abs(EMA50[b-1]-EMA50[b-13]) <= 0.5*ATR[b-1]; ER <=0.30, where ER numerator is abs(C[b-1]-C[b-31]) and denominator is the sum of the 30 absolute close changes i=b-30..b-1. Zero denominator fails.

Long trigger/entry/stop/target/room/R cap/cost/invalidation/time/cooldown are exactly as drafted: probe 0.10..1.50 ATR, close location >=0.60, next open, stop low[b]-0.25*ATR[b], target frozen M, room >=1R, R<=2.5*ATR[b], R/entry>=1%, invalidation close < low[b], time close b+24/open b+25, cooldown b' >= b+7.
All threshold decisions use exact fractions of the float inputs and decimal constants; written equalities pass and strict comparisons remain strict.
frozen_c4_short_mirror: high[b] >= RH+0.10*ATR[b-1] and <= RH+1.50*ATR[b-1]; C[b] < RH; close location <=0.40; C[b] > M.
stop=high[b]+0.25*ATR[b]; entry=open[b+1]; skip if entry>=stop; R=stop-entry; target=M; room requires entry-M >=1R; invalidation is C>high[b] strictly. Other rules mirror the long side.

prereg.rule_text:
C4 `range_extreme_reversion.v0`: research-only signal detector + per-symbol simulator (synthetic fixtures first).

Frozen contract (later overrides earlier): Build draft #13 6232236186, Codex FREEZE 6232261614 (authoritative; it pins
the short mirror explicitly, the exact-Fraction threshold rule and the skip order).
DEVELOPMENT ONLY: this module reads no cache, store, archive or holdout and is registered nowhere (not
strategies.STRATEGIES, not engine slots / sleeves / presets, not the app). It runs on an in-memory frame (columns o, h, l,
c; optional v / t; optional `e50` / `atr` to inject the indicators in fixtures).

Indicators (the existing strategies implementation, pinned, as in C3):
  EMA50 = strategies.ema(close, 50) = pandas ewm(span=50, adjust=False), seeded with EMA[0] = close[0].
  ATR14 = strategies.indicators()['atr']: TR = max(H-L, |H-C[-1]|, |L-C[-1]|) (TR[0] = H[0]-L[0]), Wilder ewm
    alpha 1/14, adjust=False, seeded with TR[0].
Cost constants are imported from backtest (FEE taker 5 bps per fill, SLIP 2 bps per fill, FUND_PER_BAR 5e-5 per 4h
bar on the real closes of bars e..x inclusive, always a cost) - the accepted C2/C3 parity convention.

Rules (long; the short is implemented by running the long code on (-o, -l, -h, -c), which yields exactly the pinned
short rules below; ATR, the |EMA50 slope| and ER are mirror-invariant). Signal bar b, 4h closed bars.
  eligibility: b >= 220; EMA50[b-1], EMA50[b-13] finite; ATR14[b-1], ATR14[b] finite and > 0.
  box (bars b-30..b-1 inclusive; bar b excluded): RH = max high, RL = min low, W = RH - RL, M = (RH + RL) / 2.
  regime: 4.0 ATR[b-1] <= W <= 12.0 ATR[b-1]; |EMA50[b-1] - EMA50[b-13]| <= 0.5 ATR[b-1];
    ER = |C[b-1] - C[b-31]| / sum_{i=b-30..b-1} |C[i] - C[i-1]| <= 0.30 (zero denominator fails).
  long trigger at close b: RL - 1.50 ATR[b-1] <= low[b] <= RL - 0.10 ATR[b-1]; C[b] > RL (strict);
    H[b] > L[b] and (C[b] - L[b]) >= 0.60 (H[b] - L[b]); C[b] < M (strict).
  short trigger (pinned): RH + 0.10 ATR[b-1] <= high[b] <= RH + 1.50 ATR[b-1]; C[b] < RH; H[b] > L[b] and
    (C[b] - L[b]) <= 0.40 (H[b] - L[b]); C[b] > M.
  trade: entry E = open[b+1]; stop = low[b] - 0.25 ATR[b] (short high[b] + 0.25 ATR[b]); target = M (frozen).
    Skip order: E <= stop (gap_stop) -> R = E - stop > 2.5 ATR[b] (quality; equality passes) -> M - E < 1.0 R
    (room; equality passes; a gap entry at/beyond the mean fails here) -> R < 1.0% x E (real price) (cost_guard).
  exits (bar k >= b+1): at open[k], a gap through stop (O <= stop) or target (O >= M) fills at the open and owns the
    label, even over a pending close-rule exit; else a pending close-rule exit fills at open[k]; else intrabar stop
    (L <= stop) beats target (H >= M), both at their level; then at close[k]: C[k] < low[b] -> invalidation (strict;
    short C[k] > high[b]), k == b+24 -> time; invalidation wins; fills at open[k+1] (time: open b+25, 25 funding bars).
  cooldown / consumption (symbol level, both sides): a candidate passing every regime and trigger rule is a signal iff
    b >= previous signal b + 7; every signal consumes (taken, no-next-bar, gap/quality/room/cost-skipped,
    overlap-ignored); a failed gate consumes nothing and a cooldown-blocked candidate does not extend the cooldown.
  one trade per symbol: a signal at b is taken only when no trade is open at the close of b (a trade whose exit fills at
    open[b+1] still owns the slot; an open_end trade owns it for the rest of the dataset); otherwise it is ignored.
  same-b long/short conflict is unreachable (close location >= 0.60 and <= 0.40 on one H > L bar); asserted.
Every threshold comparison is exact (fractions of the float inputs and of the decimal constants), so equality fixtures
follow the written operators exactly.
